content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body: $AGNT closed at its lowest level in 5 years. Three red sessions running.
$GPK needs 11.5 to turn the bounce into a reclaim.

$RBLX buyers showed up at 51 again.
Below 51, the floor is gone.

queue.headline: Jobless claims aren't signaling a slowdown
queue.body: Claims are averaging 195k a week this month, 12.8% below a year ago. Growth is still running hot while inflation cools.

$MTG needs 29.4 back.
Below that level, the advance is still stalling out.

queue.headline: $FMC's quarter erased the rebound case
queue.body: $FMC is down -50.1% over the last quarter. The prior setup is gone.
$ECG never reached the 123 entry. The setup never triggered.

queue.headline: Energy is drawing traffic
queue.body: $XLE is among today's most-traded names.
queue.supply_why: dollar-volume rank #57 ($2.5B a day), inside the top 100 by liquidity

queue.body: $DTM needs a close above 120 before the rebound means anything.

queue.headline: $SHEN closes the week at a 5-year low
queue.body: The price where the most shares changed hands over the past six months is now overhead.

queue.headline: $UNH just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 85% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 59 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.
